Physical manifestation: Even without the disc being played, Sarah can manifest herself in the real world. Sentience manipulation: On some level, Sarah can manipulate the awareness that her victims are able to have in their body. Nightmare inducement: After investigating the disc, Tom starts to have nightmares about Sarah. Background: In the present day, Sarah is completely consumed in her quest of vengeance. Swearing off her former friends before killing them all, Sarah's death has caused her. While somewhat excusable at first due to her death, Sarah's morals start crumbling apart the moment she starts attacking Tom and Kyle, two children who are completely unrelated to the incident at hand. This twisted sense of justice has led Sarah to become absolutely controlling over her domain at all times, leading to her exploding in anger the second Luther starts to fight back. Her reign, lasting over a decade long, is the main cause for these newfound tendencies, due to Sarah going mad with power that she didn't have when she died. Her inability to let go of her past combined with someone Despite it all, the people she was closest to, her family and Lily, are spared from her wrath. Unable to grapple with the idea of them moving on, the idea of the pain that they went through after her death was one of the key reasons why Sarah started her spree to begin with. The realization that Kyle was adopted by Lily in Sarah's honor only destroyed her further after killing Kyle. While she was alive, Sarah was not exactly the greatest person, but nowhere near the monster her death had created. Within the friend group, Sarah's relationship with Michael and Martin was strained at best, with her not exactly having been the greatest to them. Her friendship with Luther, however, was much more warm and genuine, likely contributing to her decline in mental state as he was the one who dealt the killing blow to her. Her relationship with both her family and her girlfriend, Lily, was also extremely positive, with the two of them promising to be together forever before the tragedy struck. All in all, Sarah is flawed. She knows what she is doing is too far gone, but another part of her (heavily fueled by Atem) wants her to continue her broken crusade. This conflict of interests has led to the creation of an incredibly conflicted entity, her quest for vengeance leading her down a path of self-destruction degrading her very soul.
